issues.description: Server error message_types are detected but silently logged instead of failing the stream
issues.detail: auth_error, quota_exceeded, transcriber_error, input_error, and error from the server are not surfaced. Silent continuation hides auth/quota failures from operators. Raise APIStatusError or surface on the event channel and trigger reconnect.

issues.description: audio_format built by f-string and cast to STTAudioFormat without validating sample_rate
issues.detail: `f"pcm_{sample_rate}"` is cast past the STTAudioFormat Literal, so sample_rate=12345 yields a bogus value the server rejects far from the call site. Validate sample_rate against the allowed set or accept STTAudioFormat directly. The Literal exists for this reason.

issues.description: STTv2 duplicates STT instead of being parameterized by model/version
issues.detail: Splitting v2 into its own class, stream, and options doubles the maintenance surface and couples imports to vendor versioning. 'Deepgram did this' is not justification. Parameterize a single STT by model, or document the specific protocol divergence that prevents unification.

issues.description: _speaking flag with empty-commit sentinel is an unstated invariant not preserved across reconnects
issues.detail: A mutable boolean braids segment identity, transcript value, and event ordering. The empty committed_transcript end-of-segment sentinel is undocumented, and _reconnect_event never resets _speaking, so a mid-utterance reconnect leaves START/END_OF_SPEECH unbalanced. Model the segment explicitly and reset on reconnect.

issues.description: commit_strategy hardcoded to 'vad' while STTCommitStrategy Literal advertises a knob
issues.detail: The exported type lies about configurability — _connect_ws hardcodes commit_strategy=vad. Either thread the value through as a parameter or remove the Literal. Do not advertise a choice the code does not honor.

issues.description: tasks_group.exception() on a cancelled gather raises CancelledError and can mask reconnect logic
issues.detail: After gracefully_cancel + cancel(), calling .exception() on a cancelled Future raises CancelledError rather than suppressing the warning. Wrap in try/except CancelledError or drop the call. Current shape can swallow exceptions that drive the reconnect path.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The most urgent issue is that known server errors (auth, quota, transcriber, input) are detected but silently logged instead of failing the stream or triggering reconnect. The audio_format is built by string interpolation and cast past its Literal type without validating sample_rate, and the v2/v1 class split duplicates surface area for vendor versioning rather than parameterizing by model. The _speaking state machine braids identity, value, and time across handlers with an undocumented empty-commit sentinel and no reset on reconnect, while commit_strategy is hardcoded despite an exported Literal advertising choice. Fix error propagation, validate the format, unify or justify v2, and tighten the speaking-segment lifecycle before merge.
